description:
A per-1,000-token price shared by every model that names it.

A model refers to one of these with `pricing_key`. The gateway looks the price up in the environment's own pricing documents first and in the global catalog second; a model with no `pricing_key`, or one whose key matches no document, falls back to its inline `cost`.

input_per_1k.description: Prompt token price in USD per 1,000 tokens.

key.description: Value a model's `pricing_key` is matched against, compared as an exact string. Conventionally `<provider>/<model_name>`, but the gateway attaches no meaning to its parts.

output_per_1k.description: Completion token price in USD per 1,000 tokens.

title: Pricing
